quote_close_basis: Yahoo historical quote.close; split-adjusted price convention; not an unadjusted spot-price claim.
adjusted_close_basis: Provider adjclose, used as dividend-and-split-adjusted total-return proxy.
price_unit: USD if returned meta.currency is USD; checked during preparation.
volume_unit: Shares, vendor-reported historical volume; split-rescaling semantics not separately certified.
shares_outstanding: Not supplied or inferred by this preparation.
time_semantics: Timestamp labels each daily bar; exchange-local calendar date is used, not the bar timestamp as a close execution time.
